messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: WARNING: missed heartbeat from pager-relay v2 (last seen 00:00:27 ago) — potential duplicate fanout. Auto-squelch engaged.

ops-bot: Deploy started: pager-relay v2 rolling restart @ 2026-03-18T02:45Z (ci/cd) — please monitor.

jordan: seeing a spike in duplicate pages. got two pages for the same alert in <10s. Anyone seeing this?

lina: same, 02:45:18 and 02:45:22. It looks like the incidentbot retried fanout while relay was flapping.

samir: logs (tail from relay):
```
[02:45:17] heartbeater: received ping
[02:45:17] worker: queued fanout for alert id=abc123
[02:45:18] heartbeater: missed heartbeat -> mark stale
[02:45:18] worker: requeue fanout id=abc123 (retry=1)
[02:45:22] heartbeater: heartbeat restored
[02:45:22] worker: process fanout id=abc123 (retry=1)
```

samir: so two fanouts were processed. incidentbot's dedupe TTL is short and missed because entries weren't persisted during the heartbeat gap.

maria: Customer impact? Any duplicate pages outside internal oncall?

lina: Quick check of Pager logs — duplicates sent to two separate oncall endpoints for the same alert id. No duplicate SMS yet. Looks contained to slack and pagerduty channels.

jordan: Can we manually suppress duplicates for now and roll a hotfix? Suggest: extend dedupe TTL and make dedupe writes synchronous before ack.

samir: Agreed. I'll open a small patch to make dedupe write sync with heartbeat guard. Quick mitigation: increase dedupe TTL to 10s and add strict idempotency check in worker.

incidentbot: NOTE: automatic squelch will suppress repeated pages for 30s for affected alertstream.

maria: I'm going to call the oncall and tell Ops to ignore duplicate pages for the next 15 mins. @jordan can you add a short blurb in #incidents to avoid noisy wakeups?

jordan: will post: "FYI: duplicate pages observed due to pager-relay heartbeat stutter. We're mitigating, please ignore duplicates for next 15m unless alerts escalate."

lina: patch in review: `hotfix/dedupe-sync-389` — will roll after +2 approvals. Samir, can you own deploy and monitor for further duplicates?

samir: on it. Will hold rollout if duplicate rate > 1/min.

maria: tagging for postmortem: paging-integration-heartbeat-stutter. Need timeline, root cause, and mitigation to ensure dedupe persistence during restarts.

jordan: thanks team. I'll update status in 10m. :thumbsup:
